headline: Oona posts P73M 9-month profit, reversing loss
summary: Oona Insurance Corp. swung to a profit in the first nine months of the year, reversing its net loss at the end of 2025. Net income rose 247 percent on robust demand for non-life products.
why: Non-life insurers in the Philippines are small listed-market players whose underwriting results reflect demand for property and casualty cover.
